verdict.rationale: Expensify's AI assistant lets users "build rules" by asking in plain language, and there is one concrete event-driven automation: finalized reports export automatically to QuickBooks Online. Smart Limits on cards hints at policy-style controls. The evidence never describes a general rule engine with event triggers, conditions and actions, so only part of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documentation of rule types and the trigger events available, configurable conditions and actions beyond accounting export, webhook or API event triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that rules fire reliably.
